title: Application Integration
prompt:
Build a small JavaScript interface that reads a view function, requests a wallet-signed transaction, and renders an event/receipt status with correct pending and failed states.

Submit the implementation or a concise technical report with expected behavior, tests, and limitations. The automatic grader checks minimum required evidence; correctness and complete quality require human review.

public_tests.name: Evidence completeness
public_tests.note: The required-term gate is a submission check, not proof of contract correctness or security.

acceptance_criteria: Address the core objective of Application Integration and implement or describe the requested behavior.
Provide a repeatable local test plan, including a normal and a negative/boundary case.
Document relevant assumptions, version requirements, and one limitation or security risk.
hints: Write the intended state transition and access policy before coding.
Test both the expected operation and a denied/invalid operation.
Keep the exercise local, pin tool/compiler versions, and inspect every warning or failed call.

retry_policy.guidance: Use feedback to revise the implementation or evidence. A successful exercise can grant the platform base reward only once per learner and activity ID.

expected_output: A tested Application Integration submission with a repeatable result, normal and failure-case evidence, and documented assumptions.
status_note: Aligned to Section C of the attached Solidity PDF; automatic grading is only a first-pass gate and needs human review.
